title: Artifact identity envelope (DRAFT)
description: The four fields every ethos-engine artifact carries before any payload. Profile-as-identity is the load-bearing idea: two artifacts are comparable if and only if profile_sha256 matches.

artifact_type.description: Names the shape exactly. A reader that does not recognise the value fails closed rather than best-effort parsing (01-CONTRACT.md §8).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the artifact SHAPE, independent of the parser build.

parser_version.description: The engine build that produced this artifact. Distinct from schema_version: many builds can emit one shape.

profile_sha256.description: Hash of the pinned configuration profile. Changing any output-affecting knob changes this.

sha256.$comment: Lowercase hex only. Uppercase is rejected rather than folded, so one digest has exactly one spelling and a comparison cannot fail for formatting reasons.
